say: Car and van dealers, welcome to The Motoring Central. This is how it works, and what's in it for you.
cap: Car and van dealers, welcome to The Motoring Central. This is how it works, and what's in it for you.

say: Listing a car takes minutes. Type the registration, and the details fill in for you. Add your photos and your price, or bring in your whole stock from a spreadsheet or a stock feed.
cap: Listing a car takes minutes. Type the registration, and the details fill in for you. Add your photos and your price, or bring in your whole stock from a spreadsheet or a stock feed.

say: Buyers search by make, price, mileage and more, and they see your cars with your dealership's name on every advert. A car that has passed a history check is marked on its advert, so buyers can trust what they see.
cap: Buyers search by make, price, mileage and more, and they see your cars with your dealership's name on every advert. A car that has passed a history check is marked on its advert, so buyers can trust what they see.

say: Buyers message you directly, and every enquiry is saved for you as a lead. And we never take commission on the cars you sell.
cap: Buyers message you directly, and every enquiry is saved for you as a lead. And we never take commission on the cars you sell.

say: Your dashboard is more than adverts. There's a stock book, with your costs and your profit on every car, and there are sales invoices, with deposits and part exchange, ready to print.
cap: Your dashboard is more than adverts. There's a stock book, with your costs and your profit on every car, and there are sales invoices, with deposits and part exchange, ready to print.

say: You can see how every advert is doing, with the views, the saves and the enquiries. You also get your own showroom page to share, and windscreen cards to print.
cap: You can see how every advert is doing, with the views, the saves and the enquiries. You also get your own showroom page to share, and windscreen cards to print.

say: Plans start at one hundred and sixty-nine pounds plus VAT a month, depending on how many cars you list, and every plan includes vehicle history checks. Pay yearly, and you pay for nine months and get twelve.
cap: Plans start at £169 plus VAT a month, depending on how many cars you list, and every plan includes vehicle history checks. Pay yearly, and you pay for 9 months and get 12.

say: Every plan starts with thirty days free. Cancel in that time, and you pay nothing.
cap: Every plan starts with 30 days free. Cancel in that time, and you pay nothing.

say: Joining takes about five minutes. Tell us about your dealership, and upload your trade insurance, your public liability insurance and a photo ID. We check your documents, and you can start listing.
cap: Joining takes about five minutes. Tell us about your dealership, and upload your trade insurance, your public liability insurance and a photo ID. We check your documents, and you can start listing.

say: Your stock, your buyers, and no commission. Join the dealer network today, at motoring central dot co dot uk.
cap: Your stock, your buyers, and no commission. Join the dealer network today, at motoringcentral.co.uk.
